This problem has been bugging me for MONTHS now.

My juice would always spit. I tried all kinds of coil variations, different amount of cotton, etc. Nothing seemed to work.. until last night:

This is hopefully the second last combination that I try (provided I finally resolve it tonight):
28G, 5-wrap, single contact coil wrapped around the blue philips screw driver.
.6mm KGD cotton. Remove both sides of the top and bottom layers (since they are too packed).

No spitting. The problem was I actually cut my cotton too short (making it a "pancake") and the cotton did not touch the base... I don't think the thick juice came through the holes so my cotton never re-wicked... meaning I got a huge dry hit after a few hits.

But still! There's a glimmer of hope. Zero spitting. Tonight, I will try it out with the cotton touching the base. Wish me luck!
